claims.statement: The general architecture permits in-context adaptation and potential parameter-changing training.
caveats: Not all proposed mechanisms are experimentally established.

claims.statement: The pilot uses an offline browser sandbox, read-only synthetic feed every5 virtual minutes, a long-term identity and5 creed sentences.

claims.statement: The deployed pilot performs no runtime parameter updates and adapts by storing/retrieving successful trajectories.
caveats: Changes to external memory and self-description do not imply foundation-model weight training.
